mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points MoM, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and UNRATE MoM < -0.2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy in a low-inflation environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
